title.narrative: Secondary Education Transformation for Access, Relevance, and Results for Jobs

description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen Ghana's secondary education system by expanding equitable access through strategic infrastructure investments that eliminate double-tracking, improving quality and relevance through enhanced teaching, STEM/TVET programming, and digital skills development, and building robust systems for data-driven planning, monitoring, and sustainable service delivery to ensure secondary graduates acquire the foundational and practical skills needed for productive employment and higher education.
To expand access to, and improve the quality and relevance of, secondary education in Ghana.
